The '''Patchblight Path''' was the name given to the road in the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. It was inhabited by [[Mawvorr|crysfangs]] and caused the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] who wandered it to fall under the influence of the [[Dark Heart]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Patchblight Path appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
